video.description:
Learn to explain how to keep keys and passwords out of your repository: API Key, Gitignore & Secret Rotation, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
API Key - A secret string that proves to a server that your app is allowed to use its service.
Gitignore - A file that lists the files Git must never track, so private files stay out of the repository.
Secret Rotation - The habit of replacing a secret with a new one on a schedule, or right after a leak.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain API Key, Gitignore & Secret Rotation in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
API Key, Gitignore, Secret Rotation 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

API Key - A secret string that proves to a server that your app is allowed to use its service.
한국어: API Key: 앱이 서버의 서비스를 쓸 수 있음을 증명하는 비밀 문자열

Gitignore - A file that lists the files Git must never track, so private files stay out of the repository.
한국어: Gitignore: Git이 절대 추적하지 않을 파일을 적어 두어 비공개 파일이 저장소에 들어가지 않게 하는 파일

Secret Rotation - The habit of replacing a secret with a new one on a schedule, or right after a leak.
한국어: Secret Rotation: 정해진 주기로, 또는 유출 직후에 비밀 값을 새 값으로 바꾸는 습관

landscape.hook: Can you explain API Key, Gitignore and Secret Rotation in English?

dialogue.title: A key in the pull request
dialogue.setting: Reviewing a pull request with a secret

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I saw our API key in a pull request. Is that bad?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. An API key is a secret that proves our app may use the service. Never commit it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where should the key live, then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In a local xcconfig file, and the Info plist reads it, like in `key`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But someone could commit that xcconfig file by accident.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is what the gitignore is for. Add the file to the gitignore, and Git never tracks it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What about the old key in the history?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Treat it as leaked. Do a secret rotation, and make a new key.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What does secret rotation mean exactly?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You replace the secret with a new one, on a schedule or right after a leak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the old API key stops working?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, revoke it. And check the gitignore again before every release.

dialogue.code:
import Foundation
let key = Bundle.main.object(
    forInfoDictionaryKey: "API_KEY") as? String
print(key ?? "no key")
